Rosa, Tom Keller, from headquarters. I have read your name on the regional list all week. How long have you been with the company?
Nearly twelve years here, and I have worked in travel and aviation since well before that. I started in tourism.
Most good people in this business did. Have you already met the team in Bogotá?
Not yet. I have spoken to Diego twice, but I have not met anyone face to face. I think we all meet at the convention.
You do. And you should know they have asked every account manager to speak for five minutes there.
I heard. Can I ask you something? What has actually changed at headquarters since the announcement?
Honestly? We have launched the regional office and we have moved four teams into one reporting line. We have not fixed the reporting system yet, and everybody knows it.
That is the most useful thing anybody has told me this month. Thank you, Tom.
I have been with this company since 2014.

Rosa, hello, this is Carmen from the convention team. I am calling with two things. First, we have finally confirmed the dates. The regional convention is on the tenth and eleventh of November, in Bogota, and the invitations have already gone out to everybody in the commercial area. Second, and this is the part I need from you: we have asked every account manager to speak for five minutes about one client they have worked with for a long time. Not a presentation with slides. Just the story. Six people have accepted so far and I have not heard from you yet. Let me know by Friday, please.

Good afternoon. Before we open the floor, let me summarize what has changed since our last update in March. We have opened the regional office in Bogota and it has been running for two months now. We have launched two new routes inside South America, and a third one has been approved but not announced yet. On the commercial side, the four country teams have moved to a single reporting line, and nobody has lost an account in the process, which was the promise we made in March. What we have not solved yet is the reporting system. Three teams are still working in four different formats, and that is the first item on the list for the next quarter.
